master_prompt:
Create ORIGINAL production-ready character artwork for the cozy browser game BAGSEED. Study the supplied game character artwork for expressive individual faces, organic silhouettes, flowing shaped hair, convincing hands, tailored cloth folds and tasteful color-shift shading. The references are from Fields of Mistria, Legend of Mana, CrossCode and Sea of Stars. Borrow their artistic quality and design principles, not any existing character, fantasy costume, hairstyle identity or logo. This replaces rejected stiff geometric procedural art. The user dislikes robotic, square, ugly, flat Mii/Wii-looking figures. Draw thoughtful attractive illustrated indie RPG characters, not vector dolls, 3D avatars, emoji faces, plastic dolls or generic geometric figures.

EXACT CLEAN ASSET SHEET: a square image, preferably 2048 x 2048, arranged in an EVEN 5 ROW x 5 COLUMN GRID. NO drawn grid, lettering, title, labels, page shadows or background. Generous fully transparent separation between every cell. Each ROW is one person below, in that exact order. COLUMN 1: beautiful detailed hand-illustrated dialogue bust of that person, three-quarter view, relaxed welcoming expression, clean painterly pixel/illustrated JRPG finish. COLUMNS 2,3,4,5: the SAME person as a full-body detailed pixel-art GAME SPRITE, FRONT, RIGHT PROFILE, BACK, LEFT PROFILE respectively. Full body in each cell; same neutral weight-bearing idle stance in four views; visibly attached hands; shoes touching an identical baseline within each cell. Sprites designed with about 72 x 108 meaningful native pixels, not tiny placeholders. Soft carefully drawn contour transitions, chosen pixel clusters, specific hair and clothing details. Portraits more finely illustrated but exactly match the sprite person and clothes. Adults roughly four head-heights tall, with natural distinct proportions and appealing expressive faces. The child has a larger head/body ratio and unmistakable child proportions. Vary broad and slim silhouettes.

ROW 1 — PLAYER DEFAULT: young adult, androgynous presentation, average build, warm medium tan skin base #cf9670, dark warm brown short naturally tousled hair #4a2c1a, dark brown eyes, no beard/hat/glasses. Cozy green pullover HOODIE #5f9c33 with hood, cuff seams, softly folded cloth and simple kangaroo pocket; dark blue JEANS #36405a; brown SNEAKERS with cream soles. Approachable individual face, subtle asymmetrical smile. No added jewelry/logos.

ROW 2 — REMY ALVAREZ: androgynous adult, average build, warm tan skin #cf9670; thick dark brown CURLY hair #3e2a1e, distinct curved locks and cohesive silhouette, not a blocky cap. SQUARE EYEGLASSES that fit naturally, dark expressive eyes, thick brows. Mustard yellow short-sleeve T-SHIRT #e0a33a, charcoal SHORTS #3a3a44, simple brown SANDALS with visible feet. Personable creative roommate/graphic designer. No facial hair, hat or props.

ROW 3 — DOUG HASKELL: 71-year-old retired machinist, STOCKY older man, fair warm skin #e8b48f, THINNING WHITE hair #e9e2d4 at sides/back with clearly bald/thinning crown, full white MUSTACHE but NO beard, expressive sleepy eyes, softly square older face with gentle age lines. Warm human, not a frail caricature or Santa. Muted blue OVERALLS #556f8f over cream short-sleeve work shirt; steel-gray WATERING CAN clearly gripped in one attached hand in full-body views. Maintains late wife Ruth's tomatoes. NO hat, cap, backpack, glasses or invented costume. Slightly shorter, broader than young adults.

ROW 4 — PRIYA RAMAN: slim adult woman, warm medium-dark brown skin #a8704c, near-black hair #1d1612 in a SINGLE PONYTAIL, expressive dark round eyes and arched brows, inviting quietly confident face. Blue pullover HOODIE #3f7fbf, charcoal JOGGERS #2b2b33, WHITE SNEAKERS #e9e2d4. Night-shift nurse off duty, not medical uniform. NO glasses, glamour makeup, hat, bag or jewelry.

ROW 5 — POPPY SERRANO-PATEL: SEVEN-YEAR-OLD GIRL, warm medium tan skin #cf9670, black hair #1d1612 in ONE SIMPLE BUN, round child face and lively child expression. Pink short-sleeve T-SHIRT #f08ab8, golden yellow TROUSERS #f2c02a, brown sneakers with cream soles. Much shorter than adults, natural child limbs. NO adult makeup, jewelry, bows or fantasy accessories.

PRIORITIZE appealing original illustration, individually shaped nuanced faces instead of identical huge round eyes, beautiful coherent hair forms, sensitive warm shading, cloth that bends over a body, charming personality. Exactly 25 cells, each containing its one required view on transparency. These cells will be cropped into actual portrait and sprite assets; clean alignment, consistent views, empty margins and retained identities matter.
generation_method: Original image generation with supplied game art references; follow-up sprite sheets use the original cast master as the identity/style reference.

jobs.prompt:
Use the supplied original Bagseed master cast sheet as the EXACT character identity, outfit, palette, drawing-quality and style source. Create a production SPRITE ANIMATION AND PORTRAIT ASSET SHEET for ONLY the specified character. Do not include any of the other four people. Retain the organic, detailed, expressive illustrated indie-RPG character design: shaped flowing hair, specific cloth seams and folds, real connected hands and naturally shaped individual faces. This must not regress into a simple geometric doll or Mii-like avatar. No 3D rendering, vector shapes, mannequin faces, huge identical circular eyes or flat robotic bodies. Do not change the identity to a character from another game.

EXACT LAYOUT: four equal-width COLUMNS and FIVE equal-height ROWS on a fully transparent background, all cells aligned to an evenly spaced rectangular grid. No text, labels, grid lines, page shadows or background. Prefer a portrait image about 1024 x 1280 or higher. A single isolated drawing per cell, with ample transparent margins, no touching neighboring cells. Full sprites roughly 72 x 108 meaningful native pixels of detailed pixel/illustrated game artwork, drawn at larger source resolution for careful extraction. All sprite cells share one exact full-body scale, head size and feet baseline; no cropping of hair, shoes, arms or props.

ROWS 1–4: a genuine FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE in a single direction per row, all four frames in that row at the SAME view angle. Row 1 FRONT/down view; row 2 RIGHT PROFILE view; row 3 BACK/up view; row 4 LEFT PROFILE view. Within each row: frame 1 left-foot contact; frame 2 passing pose; frame 3 right-foot contact; frame 4 opposite passing pose. Show opposing arm and leg swing, gentle cloth/hair follow-through, planted-foot contact and natural weight shifts. No camera turns between frames, no teleporting limbs, disconnected hands or duplicated legs. View consistency matters.

ROW 5: three matching DIALOGUE BUST PORTRAITS in columns 1,2,3, showing NEUTRAL, FRIENDLY, CONCERNED expressions respectively. Column 4 is completely empty transparent. Portraits have thoughtful hand-drawn facial features, subtle age-appropriate shading and distinct expression changes in eyes, brows and mouth. Exact same hairstyle, skin tone and clothing as all sprite frames. No portrait background. Do not put portraits in any other row.

ONLY CHARACTER: the androgynous young adult PLAYER, first row of the supplied master sheet. Average build, warm medium tan skin #cf9670, short tousled dark brown hair #4a2c1a, brown eyes, green pullover hoodie #5f9c33, dark blue jeans #36405a, brown sneakers with cream soles. No glasses, beard, hat, jewelry or invented accessories.
